sources: IS 456:2000 clauses 26.2.2.4(b), 26.3.2, 26.5.1.2 and 26.5.3.2 including Amendment No. 1. https://law.resource.org/pub/in/bis/S03/is.456.2000.pdf
Frozen L and T specimens and two-span three-moment actions, with no torsion.

method.scope: Nominal fixed cage with one Ø20 separated bottom lap and two interleaved, two-hook Ø8 closed links. Credit only the exterior link for strength.
method.restraint: Each outer compression bar sits at a closed-link bend. The two grids are physically disjoint and each meets the restraint pitch. The pair coexists only in sagging. Verify both transfer layouts and the actual bar and tie spacings.
method.outputs: Independent section equilibrium, signed action checks and centreline takeoff. Both link marks and the nominal support for each bar appear in the checked exports.
